answer: To forge a thousand fake identities, an attacker needs a thousand distinct attested devices plus sustained compute, since each epoch's puzzle scales with registered nodes. Each agent must submit a proof-of-work tied to a hardware-rooted kernel attestation, signing a challenge nonce with a device key. A modest stake of basalt tokens is slashed on duplicate attestation, making mass sybil creation costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
